name: io.github.industrial-aiops/iaiops-energy
title: Industrial-AIOps Energy
description: Industrial-AIOps energy edition: IEC-104/DNP3/IEC-61850 read-only OT connectors on iaiops.core.

environmentVariables.name: IAIOPS_CONFIG
environmentVariables.description: Path to the iaiops endpoints config YAML (defines IEC-104/DNP3/IEC-61850 targets); omit to use the default location.

environmentVariables.name: IAIOPS_MASTER_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Master password that unlocks the encrypted secret store holding endpoint credentials.
